name: e2e_task_costs
description: One framework task as a process, three implementations on one node: a demo tile's deskew/rotation (500 frames, tiff in and out) and a tiny crop (32^3), as a MATLAB job runs it (-batch, setup([]), the function string), as a compiled job runs it (run_mccMaster.sh with the Runtime; needs PK5D_MCC_MASTER and PK5D_MCR) and as a Python job runs it (the probe script with marks, and the real entry point python -m petakit5d.jobs.exec on a call folder). Start-up and teardown per task apart from the work.
setup: for v in ml mcc py pyx; do mkdir -p {work}/$v; cp {data}/PetaKit5D_demo_cell_image_dataset/Scan_Iter_0000_0000_CamA_ch0_CAM1_stack0000_488nm_0000000msec_0106060251msecAbs_000x_003y_000z_0000t.tif {work}/$v/tile.tif; done
{python} -c "import numpy as np, petakit5d.io as io; io.write_tiff(np.zeros((64, 64, 64), np.uint16), '{work}/x.tif')"

variants.code: if exist('{work}/ml/DSR', 'dir'), rmdir('{work}/ml/DSR', 's'); end; XR_deskewRotateFrame('{work}/ml/tile.tif', 0.108, 0.3, 'SkewAngle', 32.45, 'Reverse', true, 'rotate', true, 'Save16bit', true);
